text:
Maria: Quick sync — webinar launch Mar 28. Need paid search + retarget setup, creative refresh, and inbound lead routing. TL;DR: frontload search, cap CPC, 2 retarget waves, webhook -> HubSpot, updated UTMs. Who can own what?

Sam: I can take search. Proposed first-week budget $8k, pacing weighted 60/30/10 (weekstart heavy). Top priority: core-brand + top-commercial keywords, SKAGs for top 8. Pause low performers after 48h.

Olivia: I'll own retargeting + creative refresh. Plan: two waves — 0-7d (high freq), 8-21d (lower freq + different CTA). A/B test new headlines + carousel images.

Ben: I can do webhook -> HubSpot and conversion wiring. We should standardize utm_campaign and add a campaign_id tag. Also confirm conversion event name (webinar_register).

Jordan: I’ll handle UTM mapping + GA4 goals and the Zapier flow. Will add dedupe on email and a source dimension for paid_webinar_search.

Sam: Draft campaign config (quick gist):
```
campaign: "Webinar-Mar28"
daily_budget: 8000
bidding: "tROAS"
max_cpc: 2.50
location_targets: US, CA, UK
```
I’ll create SKAGs and push ads by EOD.

Olivia: Creative brief notes:
- Variant A headline: "Faster LLM inference, lower cost"
- Variant B headline: "Ship inference, not infra"
- Use product screenshots + 16:9 demo stills
- CTA A: "Register — Live Demo"; CTA B: "Save my seat"
I’ll upload assets to the creative folder in drive.

ads-bot: Creative assets uploaded: 3 headlines, 4 hero images, 2 GIFs -> https://drive.company/marketing/webinar-mar28/assets (permission: marketing-team).

Ben: Webhook payload (sample) — will expose at /webhooks/paid-to-hs:
```
POST /webhooks/paid-to-hs
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "source": "paid-webinar-search",
  "utm_campaign": "mar28_paid_search",
  "campaign_id": "GA-XXXXX",
  "landing_page": "https://redwood.ai/webinar-mar28"
}
```
I’ll add a retry policy and basic dedupe on email.

Jordan: For UTM mapping I’ll standardize: utm_source=google, utm_medium=cpc, utm_campaign=mar28_paid_search, utm_term=keyword_name. Will also map `campaign_id` to HubSpot property `paid_campaign_id`.

Sam: Small ops note — will run a 48h monitor job to pause low CV keywords: `./scripts/pause_low_cv.sh --lookback 48h --threshold 0.5` (threshold = conversions per 1000 clicks).

Olivia: Creative rollout: wave1 (all audiences) test A/B for 72h, then promote winning headline to wave2 creative set. Wave2 will use dynamic countdown + testimonial.

Ben: Confirming conversion event = `webinar_register` in GA4 and HS. Pacing rule: reduce bids by 15% 10pm-6am local to conserve budget overnight.

Maria: Great — owners: Sam (search + SKAGs), Olivia (retarget + creative), Ben (webhook + conversion wiring), Jordan (UTM + GA4). Check-in tomorrow 11:00am PT. @channel please drop 1-line blockers before then. :thumbsup:

Sam: Noted — will have SKAG drafts + keyword lists by EOD.

Olivia: Uploading first creative set now. Will flag anything that needs product screenshots.

Ben: Webhook deployed to staging, will test with sample payloads and report results.

Jordan: GA4 goal created (webinar_register), mapped to HubSpot form event. Dedupe rule added.

Maria: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. Thanks team! :rocket:
